title: TTZipCancellationHandleContract
description: JSON Schema contract representing thread-safe reference counted cancellation token lifecycle state.

handleAddress.description: Hexadecimal memory pointer representation of the opaque CancellationToken.

strongCount.description: Current atomic strong reference count across Swift and Rust.

isCancelled.description: Atomic boolean flag indicating whether cancellation was triggered.

cancellationReason.description: Cancellation reason code (0 for user abort, 1 for timeout, 2 for error cascade).
